run_gemm_benchmark: run the pytorch_cutlass module to benchmark cuBlas and cuTlass GEMM performance on CUDA
measure_blas_timing: measure the cuBlas matrix multiplication timing for given tensors and step count
measure_tlass_timing: measure the cuTlass matrix multiplication timing for given tensors and step count
run_single_gemm_test: run a single GEMM test with specified M, N, K dimensions and dtype on CUDA
run_gemm_comparison: run the GEMM comparison across a dataset of M, N, K matrix size tuples
